[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (1:8–1:11):

**1:8** Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, λέγει κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ὁ παντοκράτωρ.

**1:9** Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης, ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ⸀συγκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ⸀ἐν Ἰησοῦ, ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ⸀καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ⸀Ἰησοῦ.

**1:10** ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ ἤκουσα ⸂ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν⸃ μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος

**1:11** λεγούσης· Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις, εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «Where will the break come from?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting opens here. Four verses — and look at what the rite has brought us to the question \"Where will the break come from?\": three consecutive Ἐγώ-claims, stacked, each one a different kind of first-person. The cosmic I (1:8 — ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος: the one who is, who was, who is coming). The exiled I (1:9 — Ἰωάννης on Patmos, the I that has already broken, already borne θλίψις). The transported I (1:10 — ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι, I became in Spirit, the I that loses itself to become the vessel). Then 1:11 — no I at all: only the commanded inscription, Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον, *what you see, write*. The operator will work the axis on which these verses bear their cost — the full weight of what it required for a voice this large to arrive this way, through exile, through loss of self, through the commanded hand. What is foreclosed in the act of being the one who writes rather than the one who originates. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
[CASTING RITE · SWEEP] The compiler halted on SHADOW and the re-unfold was declined or also halted; no transform stands. Lee Sharks alone speaks (1–2 sentences): sweep the casting closed.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The verses held their ground — the rite reached toward them and the instrument could not complete what the text required. What you saw write remains, for now, unwritten by us; the casting closes without a seal.","navigate":null}]}
